description: Work with Qualys VMDR: list hosts and the vulnerabilities found on them, look up QIDs, launch and cancel scans, manage IPs, asset groups and tags, run and download reports, and start workflows when a scan or report finishes, a new host or vulnerability is found, a vulnerability is fixed or a remediation ticket opens.

qualys_new_host_trigger.description: Runs when Qualys finds a host for the first time, through a scan or an agent, with its address, name and operating system. Hosts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.last_vulnerability_scan: When it was last scanned for vulnerabilities.
output.tracking_method: How Qualys tracks it: IP, DNS, NETBIOS or AGENT.

parameters.description: Only hosts in this asset group, by id. Leave blank for every host.
parameters.name: asset_group_id

qualys_new_ticket_trigger.description: Runs when a remediation ticket is opened, with its number, assignee, host and vulnerability. Tickets opened before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

parameters.description: Only vulnerabilities this severe or worse, from 1 (minimal) to 5 (urgent). Leave blank for every severity.
parameters.name: lowest_severity

parameters.description: Only tickets assigned to this Qualys user, by login. Leave blank for every ticket.
parameters.name: assignee

qualys_new_vulnerability_trigger.description: Runs once for each vulnerability Qualys newly finds, or finds again after it was fixed, on a host, severity 4 and 5 by default, with the host and the QID. Vulnerabilities already found when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_found: When it was first found on the host.
output.last_fixed: When it was fixed, for a fixed vulnerability.
output.port: The port it was found on, if any.
output.qid: The vulnerability's QID; look it up with 'Look up vulnerabilities'.

parameters.description: Only vulnerabilities this severe or worse, from 1 (minimal) to 5 (urgent). Leave blank for 4 and 5 (critical and urgent).
parameters.name: lowest_severity

parameters.description: Only hosts in this asset group, by id. Leave blank for every host.
parameters.name: asset_group_id

qualys_report_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a report finishes in Report Share, with its id, title and format, ready for 'Download report'. Reports finished before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

parameters.description: Only reports that ended this way: finished, errors or canceled. Leave blank for finished.
parameters.name: outcome

qualys_scan_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a vulnerability scan finishes, ends in an error or is canceled, with its reference, title and state. Scans that ended before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.processed: Whether its results have been processed into host detections.
output.ref: The scan's reference, such as scan/1358285558.36992.
output.title: The scan's title.

parameters.description: Only scans that ended this way: finished, error or canceled. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: outcome

qualys_vulnerability_fixed_trigger.description: Runs once for each vulnerability a scan or agent finds fixed on a host, with the host, the QID and when it was fixed. Fixes made before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_found: When it was first found on the host.
output.last_fixed: When it was fixed, for a fixed vulnerability.
output.port: The port it was found on, if any.
output.qid: The vulnerability's QID; look it up with 'Look up vulnerabilities'.

parameters.description: Only vulnerabilities this severe or worse, from 1 (minimal) to 5 (urgent). Leave blank for every severity.
parameters.name: lowest_severity

parameters.description: Only hosts in this asset group, by id. Leave blank for every host.
parameters.name: asset_group_id
